verdict.rationale: The only versioning evidence is the `/v2/` prefix on the Computer Analytics API endpoint (`GET /v2/analytics/computer/usage`), alongside a published OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or versioning of the Computer MCP server itself. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning guarantees for the Computer MCP server and API, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
